notes.title: Curse of Dominion - Demo Patch 0.3.0 Zoomed in Battles
notes.content:
Highlights
New zoomed in battles for single-target actions

New slide ability in Erindos

Clearer turn readability via updated indicator portraits

Fixes and polish across combat, UI, and level geometry
[hr][/hr]New FeaturesZoomed in Battles
Single-target actions now trigger a close-up view to improve combat readability.

Added new attack, hit, and reaction animations to enhance combat visuals.

Sound effects and Music are still a work in progress.
Slide (Erindos)
You can now use a slide while exploring Erindos.

Provides a slight burst of speed for traversal.

Sound effect is still a work in progress.
Indicator Portraits
Unit portraits in battle desaturate noticeably after a unit has acted.

Makes it easier to see who still has an action remaining at a glance.
[hr][/hr]Fixes and Improvements
Filled a gap between the castle wall and stair geometry in Erindos that could trap the player. Extra stone added and collision adjusted.

Damage numbers now display full calculated damage rather than being capped by remaining HP. Overkill is reflected correctly.

Various minor fixes and polish to UI, animation states, and level collision.
[hr][/hr]Coming Soon
A new Battlemaster NPC has arrived in Erindos. They will mention that an Arena 1v1 mode is in development.

The mode is real-time action combat in third person, using the same camera style as Erindos exploration.

More details and a playable first pass are planned for a future update.

notes.title: Curse of Dominion - Demo Patch 0.2.9
notes.content:
Thank you for continuing to support the demo of Curse of Dominion! This update focuses on improving the player experience in Erindos, refining dialogue, and adding more intuitive systems for progression.

Patch Notes:

UI Enhancements: Added new sound effects to the user interface in Erindos for improved feedback and immersion.

Dialogue Updates: Adjusted character dialogue in Erindos to improve flow and clarity.

Objective Menu: Added an objective menu to the main menu in Erindos, making it easier to track your current goals.

Quit Confirmation: Implemented a confirmation prompt when selecting the "Quit Game" option, preventing accidental exits.

Commander Recruitment: Improved the commander recruiting system for greater clarity. The tutorial now requires exactly five commanders, and recruitment is capped at five until the tutorial is completed. Afterward, additional commanders can be recruited freely.

notes.title: Curse of Dominion - Demo Patch 0.2.8 - Polish and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
This update focuses on smoothing out rough edges and improving the overall demo experience. Thank you to everyone who has been reporting issues—it really helps me track down and fix problems quickly!

Updates in this patch:

Fixed a bug where the character would jump when closing menus if the jump button was bound to the deselect button (default on controller).

Updated the background music in Erindos to better match the city’s atmosphere.

Fixed an issue where fast travel to allied commanders would not work properly on the first load.

Fixed a bug that could cause the menu to become unresponsive under certain conditions.

Added button prompts to the dialogue UI to make controls clearer during conversations.

notes.title: Curse of Dominion - Demo Patch 0.2.7 - DLSS Restored
notes.content:
Thank you again for playing and sharing your feedback on Curse of Dominion!

Updates in this patch:

Restored DLSS support. It is now stable and ready to use for improved performance and visual quality.

Continued backend optimizations to ensure smoother gameplay and stability.

I’ll keep refining the demo as I prepare for the bigger updates ahead—your feedback makes a huge difference!

notes.title: Curse of Dominion - Demo Patch 0.2.6 - Black Screen on Launch Fix
notes.content:
Thank you for your patience and support as I continue refining Curse of Dominion!

Fixed a critical issue that caused the game to crash on startup for some players.

Temporarily disabled DLSS and NVIDIA Reflex while I work on improving their stability. These features will return in a future update once they are functioning reliably.

notes.title: Curse of Dominion - Demo Patch 0.2.5
notes.content:
This update focuses on improving battle flow, fixing persistence issues, and enhancing visuals for a more polished experience.

Changes & Fixes

Fixed an issue where characters who died in battle would remain dead in future battles.

Updated mud textures to appear greener and blend more naturally with surrounding grass.

Dominion Revival charges now reset properly after each battle.

HP and SP are now fully restored after battle.

Level-up dialogue boxes now clear correctly after battle.

Game instance data now fully resets when returning to the main menu, preventing unintended carryover between sessions.

notes.title: Curse of Dominion – Demo Patch 0.2.4
notes.content:
This update focuses on behind-the-scenes improvements to support upcoming content, along with visual and performance enhancements to Erindos.

Updates:

Visual updates beyond the castle walls: Enhanced distant terrain surrounding Erindos to improve the backdrop for future cutscenes. These changes do not affect the playable area.

Performance optimizations: Adjusted environment assets to reduce memory usage and improve overall performance.

notes.title: Curse of Dominion – Demo Patch 0.2.3
notes.content:
This patch addresses several important bugs related to battle interactions and the Help Menu.

Changelog:

Preview Tiles Not Appearing After Deselect
Fixed an issue where preview tiles (movement, attack, and support ranges) would not appear after pressing Deselect without opening the action menu or moving the cursor. Preview tiles now display immediately after deselecting a character.

Help Menu Not Blocking Input
Fixed a bug where opening the Help Menu during battle did not block inputs, allowing unintended actions to occur. Battle inputs are now properly disabled while the Help Menu is open.

Help Menu Navigation Buttons Unresponsive
Resolved an issue where the Next and Back buttons in the Help Menu did not function during battle. These buttons now work correctly both in battle and at Erindos.

notes.title: Curse of Dominion - Demo Patch 0.2.2
notes.content:
Hello, adventurers! This patch adds visual enhancements to Erindos, a new help menu for battle guidance, and key bug fixes for better stability and flow. Your feedback is invaluable, especially with the Kickstarter launching on September 2nd. If you're enjoying the demo, don't forget to wishlist on Steam!
New Features
Help Menu: Added a help menu accessible from the main menu. It opens automatically during the tutorial and includes pages on battle mechanics, strategies, and tips.
Visual Improvements
Enhanced Erindos visuals with a pond, inner keep wall, and larger keep structure. Note: Inner keep access is not yet available in this demo.
Bug Fixes
\[Performance] Fixed Nvidia DLSS not applying on startup. 

\[Ability Preview] Fixed Empower Weapon not clearing previous movement/attack preview tiles. Visuals now update immediately.

\[UI] Fixed damage indicators showing "0 damage" and critical on the first hit per session. 

Thanks for playing! Share issues or suggestions in the comments or community channels. More updates coming soon.

- Brock

notes.title: Curse of Dominion - Demo Patch 0.2.1
notes.content:
New Features

UI Improvements:

Action button icons have been added to all UI menus in Erindos for improved clarity and ease of use.

Bug Fixes

\[Inventory] Stockpile Equip Bug:

Fixed an issue where, if the stockpile page was empty, selecting "Equip" would still equip the last item stored in memory—even though no item was visibly selected.

notes.title: Curse of Dominion – Demo Update #1
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

The first major update for the Curse of Dominion demo is now live. Here’s exactly what’s new:

Erindos – Player Hub

Speak with your allies between battles.

Prepare for upcoming missions, swap gear, and manage your party.

Reclassing System (up to Level 15)

Experiment with new classes and builds as your units grow.

Persistent Saves

Your progress now carries over between play sessions.

Existing saves should still load, but starting fresh is recommended for the clearest experience.

Equipment Management

Customize each unit’s weapons and accessories from the hub for deeper strategy.

Coming Soon

Interactive Tutorials – targeted for release in the next two weeks to ease new players into combat, class changes, and hub functions.

Thank you for playing and for all the feedback so far. Keep sharing your thoughts in the Steam discussions—it’s a huge help!

— Brock

notes.title: Major Demo Update Coming Soon – New Hub Area, Reclassing, and More!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Thank you so much to everyone who's played the demo so far and shared feedback. I've been hard at work on the first major update to the Curse of Dominion demo, and I wanted to give you a quick preview of what's coming.

Here’s what you can expect in the upcoming update:

Erindos, the player hub – Talk with your allies, prepare for battle, and adjust equipment between missions.

Reclassing system unlocked – Experiment with new classes all the way up to level 15!

Save progress between sessions – No more starting from scratch.

Equipment management – Customize your loadouts and prepare your party with more depth.

Tutorials added – A smoother experience for new players jumping into the world of Elvorith.

I'm currently aiming to release this update around July 25th, but depending on polish and testing, it might take a bit longer. I’ll keep you posted with a firm release date once I’m sure everything is ready.

Just a heads-up: existing save files should still be compatible, but I may recommend starting a new save with each major update—especially as class balance and game structure continue to evolve during development. That way, you’ll get the clearest experience of the game’s progression as it’s intended to play out.

Thanks again for the support – I’m blown away by how many of you have checked out the game already. Feel free to leave feedback here or in the discussions tab, and I hope you’re looking forward to the next chapter of the demo!

— Brock
